infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FitHive uses your location while you record a hike or run.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: FitHive uses your location during an activity, including when the screen is locked, so your route and distance keep recording.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow FitHive to choose photos for your profile and posts.
plugins.cameraPermission: FitHive uses your camera when you choose to take a profile photo or attach a photo to a post.

plugins.photosPermission: FitHive can access your photos when you choose to save a route card.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: FitHive can save your route cards to your photo gallery.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FitHive uses your location while you record a hike or run.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: FitHive uses your location during an activity, including when the screen is locked, so your route and distance keep recording.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: FitHive imports completed workouts and related metrics that you choose to share from Apple Health.
